## About
Garry's Auto Repair was started by Garry Oates, originally from Mount Olive. He opened the shop on Freedom Drive in Raleigh, and when it outgrew that building, it moved to its current spot on Corporation Parkway.
We provide full service auto repair as well as collision repair: electrical repairs, brake service, oil changes and body work after an accident. Our goal is to talk one-on-one with you and listen to your repair needs.
Customers rate us 4.9 from 56 Google reviews. One reviewer calls Garry "very knowledgeable and fair," and a second says they have trusted him with their vehicles for years.

## Services
- Accident Repair: Body repair after a collision, domestic or imported, luxury or SUV.
- Fender Bender Repair: Small dents and bumps fixed right.
- Frame Straightening: Getting the frame back where it belongs after a hit.
- Insurance Claims: If you're dealing with an insurance company for your repairs, we'll help you through it.
- Engine Performance: Diagnosis and Repair: Finding out why the engine isn't running right, then fixing it.
- Computer Diagnostics and Electronics: Electrical problems and warning lights tracked down.
- Brake System Repair: Brake service and repair to keep you stopping safely.
- Tune-Ups and Oil Changes: Routine upkeep. One reviewer said Garry did a great job on his wife's oil change.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday.

Q: How do I get my car in?
A: You can schedule an appointment online, give us a call, or just stop by the shop.

Q: Do you do body work on imported or luxury cars?
A: Yes. Domestic or imported, luxury or SUV, we can handle your body shop needs.

Q: Can you help with my insurance company after an accident?
A: Yes. If you're dealing with an insurance company for your repairs, we're here to help.
